policy.purpose: Single source of truth for everything the job board page (jobs.html) claims about real companies. The verifier (verify-jobs-data.js) reads jobs.html and ensures (1) every company referenced on the page exists here, and (2) every piece of placeholder/illustrative content is explicitly marked with data-illustrative='true' so users can see the disclosure. If you add a new company to jobs.html, add it here first with a careers URL you can actually open.
policy.verified_facts: Each company entry lists only facts that are publicly stated by the company itself or by a primary source (B Lab directory, IRS 990 filings, the company's own benefits/careers page). Don't add unverifiable hearsay here.
policy.illustrative: Anything quoted or attributed to a specific person (vouches, hiring-manager notes, success stories) is treated as illustrative tone-of-voice copy until we have a real signed-off testimonial. Mark it in the markup; the verifier will fail otherwise.
policy.do_not_invent: No fabricated kindness scores, applicant counts, posting timestamps, response-rate percentages, salary bands, or 'decision in N days' promises. Those metrics need a real backend before they ship.

companies.name: Patagonia
companies.why_on_list: Certified B Corporation. On-site childcare at HQ since 1983. Generous paid parental leave for all parents.

companies.name: Mozilla
companies.what: Open-source web platform; maker of Firefox.
companies.why_on_list: Backed by the non-profit Mozilla Foundation. Distributed-first workforce; manifesto commits to open, equitable internet.

companies.name: Wikimedia Foundation
companies.what: 501(c)(3) non-profit; runs Wikipedia and sister projects.
companies.why_on_list: Charitable non-profit funded by donations. Public salary bands posted on every job listing. Distributed workforce across 40+ countries.

companies.name: Buffer

companies.name: Doist
companies.why_on_list: Async-first by company policy; no scheduled meetings as a default. Fully distributed across 35+ countries.

companies.name: Code for America
companies.why_on_list: Charitable non-profit. Workers unionized in 2020 (Code for America Workers United, OPEIU Local 1010).

companies.name: Khan Academy
companies.why_on_list: Charitable non-profit. Fully remote-friendly; mission is free, world-class education for anyone.

companies.name: Kickstarter PBC

companies.name: Honeycomb
companies.why_on_list: Publishes engineering org values and on-call practices in public. Co-founders write openly about humane on-call rotations.

companies.name: Watershed
companies.why_on_list: Climate-tech mission. Public commitment to measurable corporate emissions reductions.

companies.name: Nava PBC
companies.why_on_list: PBC structure. Worked on healthcare.gov, VA, and Medicare. Mission is making government services work for the people who need them.

companies.name: DonorsChoose
companies.why_on_list: Charitable non-profit; matches donors with public-school classroom needs.

companies.name: Aira

companies.name: Beneficial State Bank
companies.why_on_list: Certified B Corporation. CDFI (Community Development Financial Institution). Bank holding company is a non-profit foundation.

companies.name: Crisis Text Line
companies.what: 501(c)(3) mental-health non-profit; free 24/7 text-based crisis support.
companies.why_on_list: Charitable non-profit. Mission-aligned employer for mental-health, social work, and engineering roles.
